from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Diluted Earnings Per Share metric (or equivalent per-share metric) found in a single filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity that filed the statement")
    diluted_eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Diluted Earnings Per Share for the period; represent losses as negative values")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label from the financial statement (e.g., 'Net loss per common share', 'Net (Loss) Income per Limited Partnership Interest')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this figure (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEPSRecord]
